title: Strict compact-support projection for isomorphic selected stages
statement: Let O and O′ be commutative rings with elements ell and mu, phi : O → O′ a ring homomorphism, and r : ℕ → ℕ monotone. Let a be a strict coefficient change whose level maps O/(ell^(r(n)+1)) → O′/(mu^(n+1)) are bijective and send [x] to [phi(x)] [def-pur-strict-etale-coefficient-transport-interfaces]. For any compactification c of a scheme morphism and any strict compact-support presentations SA and SB [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces], there are exact strict coefficient transports TX, TY, TZ and a StrictEtaleTransportProjection P. This record consists solely of the normalized open/proper compact-support square, its finite-level projection squares, tensor/quotient interchanges, and their evaluation and quotient cubes. Quotient cubes compare the composites of any normalized open/proper quotient faces. The derived finite-level coefficient functors of TX and TY are equivalences. No exceptional right adjoint or exceptional comparison is part of this assertion. Index n denotes positive exponent n+1; r need not be strictly increasing.

source.place: Construction 4.1, Construction 5.15 and Lemma 5.22 (printed pp. 21, 35–36); geometric restriction part of the parent cofinal step, generalized to any monotone selection with isomorphic selected rings. The compact-support presentations already include their evaluated derived direct images.

proof.text: Use the coefficient-only isomorphic-stage transport construction at X, Y and c.Z. Each transport has an equivalence on every derived finite-level scalar functor.

Apply the compact-support mate and quotient assembly to the three transports and their level equivalences. The resulting normalized record is StrictEtaleTransportProjection; package the two requested equivalence conjuncts.

lean.statement:
theorem strictEtaleIsomorphicStageProjection
    {O O' : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing O] [CommRing O'] {ell : O} {mu : O'}
    {phi : O →+* O'} {index : ℕ →o ℕ}
    (a : StrictEtaleCoefficientChange O O' ell mu phi index)
    (_ha : ∀ n, Function.Bijective (a.ring n))
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (SA : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O ell c) (SB : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O' mu c) :
    ∃ (TX : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a X SA.PX SB.PX)
      (TY : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a Y SA.PY SB.PY)
      (TZ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a c.Z SA.PZ SB.PZ)
      (_P : StrictEtaleTransportProjection a c SA SB TX TY TZ),
      ∀ n, (TX.level n).derived.IsEquivalence ∧ (TY.level n).derived.IsEquivalence
